files.name: ShelterDigOut.java

help: After shelter fails STUCK underground: mine a staircase up out of the shaft without needing blocks
lesson: Shelter STUCK comes from the morning exit needing a block to fill a stair step, so the follow-up should climb using only mining (a dug staircase into the shaft wall), with a block placed only if one is carried.
summary: shelter_dig_out: right after shelter fails STUCK ('couldn't climb out: couldn't fill the step'), digs its own staircase up by mining each step's head room, so it needs no blocks to get out of the covered shaft
